## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

# Worker Agents Skills

This repository bundles the baseline skills installed by [Worker
Agents](https://github.com/agents-dev/workerAgents).

The bundled skills are available under [`skills/`](skills/):

- `mcp-duckgo` — imported from `aahl/skills@mcp-duckgo`.
- `image-search` — imported from `z0gsh1u/oh-my-writing-skill@image-search`.
- `gauntlet-loop` — imported from `robonuggets/gauntlet-loop@gauntlet-loop`.
- `load-sketchfab-threejs` — local asset inspection, normalization, and Three.js/PlayCanvas A/B viewer skill.
- `opencode-zen-completions` — use the OpenCode Zen chat completions API for implementation work.

The original upstream licenses are preserved in
[`third-party-licenses/`](third-party-licenses/).

- 3D scene: hallway + living room + dining room + kitchen + basement stair / exit door. Build with primitive geometry and procedural textures (CanvasTexture). Use shadows? Performance on mobile.         w=re.search(r'font-weight: (\d+)', b).group(1)
        url=re.search(r'url\((\S+)\)', b).group(1)
        print(name, fam, w, url)

    if (options.rotY) mesh.rotation.y = options.rotY

+        const col = startCol + dx
+        const row = startRow + dz
+        if (col < 0 || row < 0 || col >= nav.cols || row >= nav.rows) continue
+        const i = row * nav.cols + col
+        if (!nav.blocked[i]) return i
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return -1
+}
+
+function findPath(start, goal) {
+  const startIndex = nearestOpen(navIndex(start.x, start.z))
+  const goalIndex = nearestOpen(navIndex(goal.x, goal.z))
+  if (startIndex < 0 || goalIndex < 0) return []
+  if (startIndex === goalIndex) return [goal.clone()]
+  const total = nav.cols * nav.rows
+  const g = new Float32Array(total).fill(Infinity)
+  const f = new Float32Array(total).fill(Infinity)
+  const came = new Int32Array(total).fill(-1)
+  const closed = new Uint8Array(total)
+  const open = [startIndex]
+  g[startIndex] = 0
+  f[startIndex] = 0
+  const goalCol = goalIndex % nav.cols
+  const goalRow = Math.floor(goalIndex / nav.cols)
+  const heuristic = (index) => {
+    const col = index % nav.cols
+    const row = Math.floor(index / nav.cols)
+    const dx = Math.abs(col - goalCol)
+    const dz = Math.abs(row - goalRow)
+    return Math.max(dx, dz) + (Math.SQRT2 - 1) * Math.min(dx, dz)
+  }
+  let iterations = 0
+  while (open.length && iterations++ < 9000) {
+    let bestIndex = 0
+    for (let i = 1; i < open.length; i++) if (f[open[i]] < f[open[bestIndex]]) bestIndex = i
+    const current = open.splice(bestIndex, 1)[0]
+    if (current === goalIndex) {
+      const path = []
+      let node = current
+      while (node !== -1) {
+        const col = node % nav.cols
+        const row = Math.floor(node / nav.cols)
+        path.push(new THREE.Vector3(nav.minX + col * nav.cell, 0, nav.minZ + row * nav.cell))
+        node = came[node]
+      }
+      return path.reverse()
+    }
+    closed[current] = 1
+    const col = current % nav.cols
+    const row = Math.floor(current / nav.cols)
+    for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
+      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
+        if (dx === 0 && dz === 0) continue
+        const nc = col + dx
+        const nr = row + dz
+        if (nc < 0 || nr < 0 || nc >= nav.cols || nr >= nav.rows) continue
+        const ni = nr * nav.cols + nc
+        if (nav.blocked[ni] || closed[ni]) continue
+        if (dx !== 0 && dz !== 0) {
+          if (nav.blocked[row * nav.cols + nc] || nav.blocked[nr * nav.cols + col]) continue
+        }
+        const cost = dx !== 0 && dz !== 0 ? Math.SQRT2 : 1
+        const tentative = g[current] + cost
+        if (tentative >= g[ni]) continue
+        came[ni] = current
+        g[ni] = tentative
+        f[ni] = tentative + heuristic(ni)
+        if (!open.includes(ni)) open.push(ni)
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return []
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- enemy
+const enemy = {
+  active: false,
+  hp: 100,
+  stunned: 0,
+  dead: false,
+  deadTimer: 0,
+  attackTimer: 0,
+  attackCooldown: 0,
+  walkPhase: 0,
+  path: [],
+  pathIndex: 0,
+  pathTimer: 0,
+  lastSeen: new THREE.Vector3(),
+  search: 0,
+  patrol: null,
+  patrolWait: 0,
+  speed: 0,
+}
+
+function lineOfSight(from, to) {
+  const dir = tempVec.copy(to).sub(from)
+  const dist = dir.length()
+  if (dist < 0.01) return true
+  dir.normalize()
+  raycaster.set(from, dir)
+  raycaster.far = dist - 0.12
+  const hit = raycaster.intersectObjects(world.occluders, false)
+  return hit.length === 0
+}
+
+function spawnEnemy() {
+  if (game.enemySpawned || game.state === 'dead' || game.state === 'won') return
+  game.enemySpawned = true
+  enemy.active = true
+  const group = world.enemy.group
+  group.position.set(0, floorAt(8.2), 8.2)
+  group.visible = true
+  enemy.lastSeen.set(player.pos.x, 0, player.pos.z)
+  enemy.search = 9
+  enemy.pathTimer = 0
+  player.shake = 0.8
+  audio.stinger()
+  showCaption('IT HEARD YOU.', 'RUN.', 3800)
+  showToast('THE TENANT IS AWAKE')
+  dom.hurt.classList.remove('hit')
+  void dom.hurt.offsetWidth
+  dom.hurt.classList.add('hit')
+}
+
+function angleLerp(a, b, t) {
+  let delta = (b - a + Math.PI) % (Math.PI * 2) - Math.PI
+  if (delta < -Math.PI) delta += Math.PI * 2
+  return a + delta * t
+}
+
+function damagePlayer(amount) {
+  if (game.state !== 'playing') return
+  player.health = Math.max(0, player.health - amount)
+  player.shake = 0.9
+  player.hurtPulse = 0.8
+  updateVitals()
+  audio.playerHit()
+  dom.hurt.classList.remove('hit')
+  void dom.hurt.offsetWidth
+  dom.hurt.classList.add('hit')
+  if (player.health <= 0) {
+    die(player.health <= 0 && game.enemyDead ? 'The house is quiet now. Almost.' : 'Break line of sight. You can stagger it with the handgun.')
+  }
+}
+
+function hitEnemy(damage) {
+  if (!enemy.active || enemy.dead) return
+  enemy.hp -= damage
+  enemy.stunned = 0.9
+  enemy.lastSeen.set(player.pos.x, 0, player.pos.z)
+  enemy.search = 9
+  audio.enemyHit()
+  dom.reticle.classList.add('hit')
+  setTimeout(() => dom.reticle.classList.remove('hit'), 150)
+  if (enemy.hp <= 0) {
+    enemy.dead = true
+    game.enemyDead = true
+    enemy.deadTimer = 0
+    enemy.stunned = 0
+    showCaption('It is down. Not dead. Do not wait.', '', 3800)
+    showToast('THE TENANT IS DOWN')
+    audio.stinger()
+  }
+}
+
+function updateEnemy(dt) {
+  if (!enemy.active) return
+  const group = world.enemy.group
+  const parts = world.enemy.parts
+  const time = performance.now() * 0.001
+
+  if (enemy.dead) {
+    enemy.deadTimer += dt
+    group.rotation.z = damp(group.rotation.z, 1.35, 3, dt)
+    group.position.y = damp(group.position.y, floorAt(group.position.z) - 0.5, 2.5, dt)
+    parts.lanternLight.intensity = damp(parts.lanternLight.intensity, 0, 1.5, dt)
+    parts.arms[0].rotation.x = damp(parts.arms[0].rotation.x, -0.6, 2, dt)
+    parts.arms[1].rotation.x = damp(parts.arms[1].rotation.x, 0.4, 2, dt)
+    parts.head.rotation.z = damp(parts.head.rotation.z, 0.7, 1.5, dt)
+    return
+  }
+
+  if (enemy.stunned > 0) {
+    enemy.stunned -= dt
+    group.rotation.z = Math.sin(time * 28) * 0.07
+    parts.head.rotation.z = Math.sin(time * 19) * 0.1
+    parts.arms[1].rotation.x = damp(parts.arms[1].rotation.x, -0.3, 8, dt)
+    parts.lanternLight.intensity = 2 + Math.sin(time * 20) * 1.2
+    return
+  }
+  group.rotation.z = damp(group.rotation.z, 0, 8, dt)
+
+  enemy.attackCooldown = Math.max(0, enemy.attackCooldown - dt)
+  enemy.attackTimer = Math.max(0, enemy.attackTimer - dt)
+  const chest = tempVec.set(group.position.x, group.position.y + 1.45, group.position.z)
+  const playerChest = tempVec2.set(player.pos.x, player.camY - 0.12, player.pos.z)
+  const distance = chest.distanceTo(playerChest)
+  const los = lineOfSight(chest, playerChest)
+  if (los) {
+    enemy.lastSeen.set(player.pos.x, 0, player.pos.z)
+    enemy.search = 7
+  } else {
+    enemy.search = Math.max(0, enemy.search - dt)
+  }
+
+  if (distance < 1.55 && los && enemy.attackCooldown <= 0) {
+    enemy.attackCooldown = 1.25
+    enemy.attackTimer = 0.42
+    damagePlayer(34)
+    parts.arms[1].rotation.x = -1.45
+    parts.arms[1].rotation.z = -0.2
+  }
+
+  let target
+  if (los && distance < 14) target = player.pos
+  else if (enemy.search > 0) target = enemy.lastSeen
+  else {
+    if (!enemy.patrol) {
+      const patrols = [
+        new THREE.Vector3(-5.8, 0, 4.5),
+        new THREE.Vector3(5.8, 0, 4.6),
+        new THREE.Vector3(5.6, 0, -2.4),
+        new THREE.Vector3(-6.0, 0, -4.1),
+        new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 2.8),
+        new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -9.5),
+      ]
+      enemy.patrol = patrols[Math.floor(Math.random() * patrols.length)]
+    }
+    target = enemy.patrol
+  }
+
+  enemy.pathTimer -= dt
+  if (enemy.pathTimer <= 0 || enemy.path.length === 0) {
+    enemy.pathTimer = 0.55
+    enemy.path = findPath(group.position, target)
+    enemy.pathIndex = 0
+  }
+
+  let moveX = 0
+  let moveZ = 0
+  const direct = distance < 3.8 && los
+  if (direct) {
+    moveX = player.pos.x - group.position.x
+    moveZ = player.pos.z - group.position.z
+  } else {
+    while (enemy.pathIndex < enemy.path.length) {
+      const node = enemy.path[enemy.pathIndex]
+      const dx = node.x - group.position.x
+      const dz = node.z - group.position.z
+      if (Math.hypot(dx, dz) < 0.34) {
+        enemy.pathIndex++
+        continue
+      }
+      moveX = dx
+      moveZ = dz
+      break
+    }
+  }
+
+  const moveLength = Math.hypot(moveX, moveZ)
+  if (moveLength > 0.04) {
+    moveX /= moveLength
+    moveZ /= moveLength
+    const speed = los ? 2.28 : 1.75
+    enemy.speed = speed
+    group.position.x += moveX * speed * dt
+    group.position.z += moveZ * speed * dt
+    const targetAngle = Math.atan2(-moveX, -moveZ)
+    group.rotation.y = angleLerp(group.rotation.y, targetAngle, 1 - Math.exp(-7 * dt))
+    enemy.walkPhase += dt * speed * 3.5
+    const swing = Math.sin(enemy.walkPhase) * 0.66
+    parts.legs[0].rotation.x = swing
+    parts.legs[1].rotation.x = -swing
+    parts.arms[0].rotation.x = -swing * 0.45
+    parts.arms[1].rotation.x = swing * 0.72
+    parts.arms[1].rotation.z = Math.sin(enemy.walkPhase * 0.5) * 0.04
+    parts.head.rotation.z = Math.sin(enemy.walkPhase * 0.35) * 0.08
+    group.position.y = floorAt(group.position.z) + Math.abs(Math.sin(enemy.walkPhase)) * 0.025
+    enemyStepTimer -= dt
+    if (distance < 9 && enemyStepTimer <= 0) {
+      audio.step(true)
+      enemyStepTimer = 0.55
+    }
+  } else {
+    enemy.speed = 0
+    parts.legs[0].rotation.x = damp(parts.legs[0].rotation.x, 0, 7, dt)
+    parts.legs[1].rotation.x = damp(parts.legs[1].rotation.x, 0, 7, dt)
+    parts.arms[0].rotation.x = damp(parts.arms[0].rotation.x, 0.1, 3, dt)
+    parts.arms[1].rotation.x = damp(parts.arms[1].rotation.x, 0, 3, dt)
+    group.position.y = damp(group.position.y, floorAt(group.position.z), 7, dt)
+    if (!los && enemy.search <= 0) {
+      enemy.patrolWait -= dt
+      if (enemy.patrolWait <= 0) {
+        enemy.patrol = null
+        enemy.patrolWait = 2.5
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  parts.lanternLight.intensity = 2.8 + Math.sin(time * 11 + 0.5) * 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.16
+  const danger = clamp((14 - distance) / 14, 0, 1) * (los ? 1 : 0.55)
+  game.danger = Math.max(game.danger, danger)
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- gunplay
+function fire() {
+  if (game.state !== 'playing' || !game.hasGun || game.reloading > 0 || fireCooldown > 0) return
+  if (game.ammo <= 0) {
+    if (game.reserve > 0) {
+      reload()
+    } else {
+      audio.empty()
+      showToast('EMPTY')
+    }
+    return
+  }
+  game.ammo--
+  game.shots++
+  fireCooldown = 0.3
+  weaponRecoil = 1
+  weaponFlash = 0.065
+  muzzleLight.intensity = 18
+  audio.gunshot()
+  player.shake = Math.max(player.shake, 0.32)
+  player.pitch = clamp(player.pitch + 0.027, -1.2, 1.1)
+  updateAmmo()
+
+  if (enemy.active && !enemy.dead) {
+    const chest = tempVec.set(world.enemy.group.position.x, world.enemy.group.position.y + 1.35, world.enemy.group.position.z)
+    const toEnemy = tempVec2.copy(chest).sub(camera.position)
+    const dist = toEnemy.length()
+    const forward = camera.getWorldDirection(tempForward)
+    const angle = forward.angleTo(toEnemy.normalize())
+    if (dist < 22 && angle < 0.13) {
+      const dir = tempVec.copy(chest).sub(camera.position).normalize()
+      raycaster.set(camera.position, dir)
+      raycaster.far = dist - 0.1
+      const wallHit = raycaster.intersectObjects(world.occluders, false)
+      if (!wallHit.length) hitEnemy(34)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+function reload() {
+  if (game.state !== 'playing' || !game.hasGun || game.reloading > 0) return
+  if (game.ammo >= 6 || game.reserve <= 0) {
+    if (game.reserve <= 0) showToast('NO SPARE ROUNDS')
+    return
+  }
+  game.reloading = 1.55
+  audio.reload()
+  updateAmmo()
+}
+
+function updateWeapon(dt) {
+  fireCooldown = Math.max(0, fireCooldown - dt)
+  if (game.reloading > 0) {
+    game.reloading -= dt
+    if (game.reloading <= 0) {
+      game.reloading = 0
+      const loaded = Math.min(6 - game.ammo, game.reserve)
+      game.ammo += loaded
+      game.reserve -= loaded
+      updateAmmo()
+    }
+  }
+  weaponFlash = Math.max(0, weaponFlash - dt)
+  muzzleLight.intensity = weaponFlash > 0 ? 18 : 0
+  muzzleSprite.material.opacity = weaponFlash > 0 ? 0.95 : 0
+  weaponRecoil = Math.max(0, weaponRecoil - dt * 6)
+  const bob = Math.sin(player.bobTime) * (player.moving ? 0.006 : 0.0018)
+  weapon.position.set(0.235, -0.255 + bob + weaponRecoil * 0.035, -0.5 + weaponRecoil * 0.07)
+  weapon.rotation.set(0.055 + weaponRecoil * 0.22, -0.07 + Math.sin(player.bobTime * 0.5) * 0.004, weaponRecoil * 0.025)
+  torchModel.position.set(-0.235, -0.28 + bob * 0.7, -0.48)
+  torchModel.rotation.z = -0.05 + Math.sin(player.bobTime) * 0.006 * (player.moving ? 1 : 0.2)
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- world animation
+function updateDoors(dt) {
+  for (const key of ['front', 'cellar']) {
+    const door = world.doorRefs[key]
+    if (!door) continue
+    door.angle = damp(door.angle, door.target, 4, dt)
+    door.pivot.rotation.y = door.angle
+  }
+}
+
+function updateLights(dt) {
+  const time = performance.now() * 0.001
+  game.powerLevel = damp(game.powerLevel, game.powered ? 1 : 0, 1.2, dt)
+  for (const lamp of world.lamps) {
+    const power = lamp.powered ? game.powerLevel : 1
+    let flicker = 1 + Math.sin(time * lamp.speed * 1.7 + lamp.phase) * lamp.flicker * 0.3
+    flicker += (Math.random() - 0.5) * lamp.flicker * 0.22
+    if (lamp.powered && game.powerLevel < 0.98 && Math.random() > 0.16) flicker *= 0.14
+    if (game.danger > 0.55 && lamp.powered) flicker *= 0.85 + Math.sin(time * 23 + lamp.phase) * 0.12
+    lamp.light.intensity = lamp.base * power * flicker
+    if (lamp.bulbMaterial) {
+      lamp.bulbMaterial.emissiveIntensity = lamp.powered ? game.powerLevel * 2.3 * flicker : 2.3 * flicker
+    }
+  }
+  world.materials.fluorescent.emissiveIntensity = game.powerLevel * (1.9 + Math.sin(time * 7.2) * 0.22)
+  const flick = flashlightOn ? (game.danger > 0.72 && Math.random() > 0.9 ? 0.22 : 1) : 0
+  flashlight.intensity = 52 * flick
+  flashlightFill.intensity = 0.16 * (flashlightOn ? 1 : 0)
+}
+
+function updateLightning(dt) {
+  game.lightningTimer -= dt
+  if (game.lightningTimer <= 0) {
+    game.lightningTimer = 13 + Math.random() * 16
+    game.flashPower = 1
+    game.flashTick = 0
+    if (audio.ctx) {
+      setTimeout(() => {
+        audio.noiseBurst(2.6, 260, 0.11, 'lowpass')
+        audio.pulse(2.8, 31, 0.08, 'sawtooth')
+      }, 500)
+    }
+  }
+  if (game.flashPower > 0) {
+    game.flashTick += dt
+    game.flashPower = Math.max(0, game.flashPower - dt * 5.5)
+    const strobe = game.flashTick < 0.34 ? (Math.sin(game.flashTick * 75) > -0.2 ? 1 : 0.2) : 0.35
+    const value = game.flashPower * strobe
+    world.lightning.intensity = value * 5
+    world.windowMaterial.emissiveIntensity = 0.36 + value * 2.7
+    dom.lightning.style.opacity = String(value * 0.36)
+  } else {
+    world.lightning.intensity = 0
+    world.windowMaterial.emissiveIntensity = 0.36
+    dom.lightning.style.opacity = '0'
+  }
+}
+
+function updateDust(dt) {
+  const positions = world.dust.geometry.attributes.position.array
+  const time = performance.now() * 0.001
+  for (let i = 0; i < positions.length / 3; i++) {
+    const index = i * 3
+    positions[index] += Math.sin(time * 0.35 + i) * dt * 0.004
+    positions[index + 1] -= dt * 0.014 * (0.4 + (i % 5) * 0.13)
+    if (positions[index + 1] < (positions[index + 2] < -6 ? -1.75 : 0.05)) {
+      positions[index + 1] = positions[index + 2] < -6 ? 1.1 : 3.1
+    }
+  }
+  world.dust.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true
+}
+
+function updateCameraDead() {
+  player.deadTilt = damp(player.deadTilt, 1.15, 2, 1 / 60)
+  camera.rotation.z = player.deadTilt
+  camera.position.y = damp(camera.position.y, floorAt(player.pos.z) + 0.48, 2.5, 1 / 60)
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- loop
+let lastDanger = 0
+function animate() {
+  requestAnimationFrame(animate)
+  const dt = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05)
+  const state = game.state
+
+  if (state === 'title') {
+    updateTitle(dt)
+    updateLights(dt)
+    updateLightning(dt)
+    updateDust(dt)
+    updateDoors(dt)
+  } else if (state === 'playing') {
+    game.danger = 0
+    updatePlayer(dt)
+    updateInteraction()
+    updateEnemy(dt)
+    updateWeapon(dt)
+    updateDoors(dt)
+    updateLights(dt)
+    updateLightning(dt)
+    updateDust(dt)
+    if (game.powerTimer > 0) {
+      game.powerTimer -= dt
+      if (game.powerTimer <= 0) spawnEnemy()
+    }
+    audio.update(dt, game.danger)
+  } else {
+    if (state === 'dead') updateCameraDead()
+    updateLights(dt)
+    updateLightning(dt)
+    updateDust(dt)
+    updateDoors(dt)
+    updateWeapon(dt)
+    audio.update(dt, 0)
+  }
+
+  lastDanger = game.danger
+  renderer.render(scene, camera)
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- boot
+setupInteractions()
+buildNav()
+updateVitals()
+renderInventory()
+updateAmmo()
+camera.position.set(0, 1.63, 7.36)
+camera.rotation.set(-0.055, 0.035, 0)
+
+setTimeout(() => {
+  dom.loading.classList.add('hidden')
+  dom.title.classList.remove('hidden')
+}, 550)
+
+window.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
+  if (document.hidden && game.state === 'playing') pauseGame()
+})
+
+window.__BLACKWATER__ = {
+  game,
+  player,
+  world,
+  enemy,
+  scene,
+  camera,
+  renderer,
+  startGame,
+  powerOn,
+  spawnEnemy,
+  fire,
+  interact,
+  nav,
+  findPath,
+  teleport(x, z, yaw = player.yaw) {
+    player.pos.x = x
+    player.pos.z = z
+    player.pos.y = floorAt(z)
+    player.yaw = yaw
+    player.camY = floorAt(z) + 1.62
+  },
+  giveAll() {
+    game.fuses = 2
+    renderInventory()
+    weapon.visible = true
+    game.hasGun = true
+    game.ammo = 6
+    game.reserve = 6
+    updateAmmo()
+  },
+}
+
+animate()
+

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a polished, original first-person survival-horror game for mobile, inspired by Resident Evil 7, playable in the browser.

## Requirements
- First-person perspective, mobile-first with touch controls, also keyboard/mouse.
- Should feel like RE7: derelict house, scarce resources, exploration, puzzle, stalking enemy, escape objective.
- Must be an original game/name, not use Resident Evil assets or IP.

## Decisions
- Web app using vendored Three.js r160; no build step, static `index.html`.
- Original title: **BLACKWATER — Chapter I: The House That Waits**.
- Short playable chapter: find 2 fuses, restore breaker power, enter cellar, take iron key, escape front door while “The Tenant” stalks the player.
- Procedural canvas textures and procedural Web Audio; no external game assets.
- Mobile controls: dynamic left-thumb joystick, right-side drag look, interact/fire/run/flashlight buttons.
- Static world geometry merged by material for performance; player/enemy/doors/interactables remain dynamic.
- HUD/screen visibility changed from opacity transitions to `display:none` because CSS transitions stalled in headless/software-rendered testing.
- Flashlight viewmodel hidden because it rendered as a distracting white ring; world flashlight light remains active.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built `index.html`, `styles.css`, `src/main.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/textures.js`, `src/audio.js`.
- Vendored Three.js and BufferGeometryUtils.
- Added visual style, title screen, loading screen, HUD, pause/note/death/win overlays, mobile controls.
- Built multi-room farmhouse: foyer, hall, living room, dining room, kitchen, study, cellar/stairs.
- Implemented movement, mouse/touch look, sprint/stamina, collisions, flashlight, pickups, inventory, notes, breaker puzzle, cellar door, key, win/death states.
- Implemented handgun viewmodel, shooting, ammo/reload, enemy model/AI/pathfinding via A*, enemy attack, stun/death.
- Implemented procedural audio, lightning, dust, flickering lights, title camera.
- Added debug API `window.__BLACKWATER__`.
- Verified no runtime errors; desktop/mobile screenshots produced successfully.
- Added mobile move-hint ring and changed run icon to double-chevron.

### Active
- Final visual/UX polish and end-to-end gameplay validation after latest edits.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check src/*.js` after latest edits.
2. Re-test desktop and mobile screenshots, especially HUD display and hidden flashlight viewmodel.
3. Test full loop with `window.__BLACKWATER__`: fuse pickups, breaker/power, cellar/key, win.
4. Test enemy chase/death and A* through hall/cellar.
5. Inspect gun viewmodel when equipped; fix layout if it clips or looks incorrect.
6. Verify mobile joystick hint hides/shows correctly and buttons do not overlap.
7. Improve lighting/brightness if screenshots are too dark.
8. Optionally update `README.md` with game controls/description.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: markup for title/HUD/overlays/mobile controls.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: full UI/visual styling and responsive/mobile rules.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: game loop, input, interactions, enemy AI, gunplay, win/death, debug API.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: world geometry, props, lights, enemy mesh, static geometry merge.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/textures.js`: procedural canvas textures.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: procedural Web Audio soundscape.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three.module.js`: Three.js r160 runtime.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/BufferGeometryUtils.js`: geometry merging.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/fonts/`: vendored Bodoni Moda and Barlow Condensed fonts.

## Important Context
- Local server currently running: `python3 -m http.server 3002` in tmux session `game`; URL `http://localhost:3002`.
- Browser testing: `playwright-cli` expects Chromium build 1243 but installed build is 1248; use Node Playwright with `executablePath: '/usr/bin/chromium'` and `args: ['--use-angle=swiftshader','--no-sandbox']`.
- DISPLAY is `:0`; Xvfb is running.
- Screenshot test files at `screenshots/` including `desktop-title.png`, `desktop-game.png`, `mobile-title.png`, `mobile-game.png`.
- Debug helpers: `window.__BLACKWATER__.teleport(x,z,yaw)`, `.powerOn()`, `.spawnEnemy()`, `.giveAll()`, `.interact()`, `.fire()`, plus exposed `game/player/world/enemy/camera/renderer/nav/findPath`.
- World coords: house x∈[-9,9], z∈[-6,9]; cellar z∈[-11,-6], floor y=-1.8; hall x∈[-2,2]; breaker at `(1.89,1.5,-1.2)`; fuse kitchen at `(8.02,0.94,-3.35)`; fuse study at `(-6.55,0.86,-4.02)`; key at `(0,-0.77,-9.82)`; gun at `(5.25,0.91,5.03)`.
- Enemy spawn at `(0,0,8.2)` after ~2.1s from `powerOn()`.
- Testing showed CSS opacity transitions can remain at 0 in headless; critical overlays now use `display:none`, and screenshot reliability improved.
- Static geometry merge reduced draw calls from ~317 to ~174; software renderer timing was acceptable (~4–10 ms/render after shaders compiled).
- Changes are uncommitted/untracked in the repo.

export function maskTexture() {
  return canvasTexture(256, (ctx, s) => {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, s, s)
    const shade = ctx.createRadialGradient(104, 92, 12, 128, 136, 118)
    shade.addColorStop(0, '#d6ccb7')
    shade.addColorStop(0.62, '#bdb29b')
    shade.addColorStop(1, '#8e8370')
    ctx.fillStyle = shade
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(128, 136, 75, 106, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2)
    ctx.fill()

    // Uneven, hollow sockets.
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d0b09'
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(100, 116, 17, 10, -0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(157, 113, 12, 15, 0.16, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(198,187,164,.5)'
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(155, 108, 3, 2.4, 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()

    // Narrow nasal slit.
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(24,19,14,.9)'
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(128, 137)
    ctx.lineTo(119, 160)
    ctx.lineTo(135, 159)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()

    // Mouth sewn shut with a crooked vertical seam and cross stitches.
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2b2319'
    ctx.lineWidth = 4
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(128, 174)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(121, 200, 130, 230)
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#6c5d46'
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.4
    for (let y = 178; y <= 224; y += 8) {
      const drift = Math.sin(y * 0.4) * 4
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(114 + drift, y)
      ctx.lineTo(139 + drift, y + 2)
      ctx.stroke()
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(50,37,25,.45)'
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(128, 150); ctx.lineTo(134, 170)
    ctx.moveTo(174, 178); ctx.lineTo(184, 168)
    ctx.moveTo(80, 196); ctx.lineTo(70, 210)
    ctx.stroke()
  })
}

# PlayGround

## BLACKWATER — Chapter I: The House That Waits

A short first-person survival-horror chapter built to run in the browser with no build step. The road is gone, the lights are dead, and something wearing a sewn-shut mask is walking the halls.

**Objective:** find two ceramic fuses, restore the breaker in the hall, descend into the cellar for the iron key, and escape through the front door.

### Play

Serve the folder with any static file server and open `index.html`.

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3002
```

Then visit `http://localhost:3002`.

### Controls

| Action | Keyboard / mouse | Touch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Move | `WASD` / arrow keys | Left-thumb joystick |
| Look | Mouse | Drag on the right side |
| Interact | `E` | Hand button |
| Fire | Left click / `Space` | Fire button |
| Run | `Shift` | Double-chevron button |
| Flashlight | `F` | Torch button |
| Reload | `R` | — |
| Pause | `Esc` | Pause button |

Headphones are recommended. The game uses procedural Web Audio for its soundscape and procedurally generated canvas textures for the world, so there are no external art or audio assets.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build and polish an original, browser-playable, mobile-first first-person survival-horror game inspired by Resident Evil 7.
- Current title: **BLACKWATER — Chapter I: The House That Waits**.

## Requirements
- First-person perspective with touch controls plus keyboard/mouse.
- RE7-like derelict-house exploration, scarce resources, a puzzle, a stalking enemy, and an escape objective.
- Original game/name; no Resident Evil assets or IP.
- Mobile-first presentation and functional touch UI.

## Decisions
- Static web app using vendored Three.js r160; no build step; entry point `index.html`.
- Chapter loop: find two fuses → restore breaker → open cellar → take iron key → escape front door while “The Tenant” stalks the player.
- Procedural canvas textures and procedural Web Audio; no external game assets.
- Mobile controls: dynamic left-thumb joystick, right-side drag look, interact/fire/run/flashlight buttons.
- Static world geometry merged by material for performance.
- Critical overlays use `display:none` rather than opacity transitions for reliable headless rendering.
- Flashlight world light remains active but flashlight viewmodel stays hidden.
- Gun viewmodel now uses unlit `MeshBasicMaterial` parts, is scaled/repositioned separately for touch vs desktop, and no longer shows a hand box.
- Mask/portrait textures were redesigned to be less cartoonish and more unsettling.
- Lighting raised slightly: hemisphere `0.66`, tone-mapping exposure `1.17`.
- Enemy patrol points were moved out of furniture colliders so A* can reach them.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full playable chapter implemented: foyer, hall, living room, dining room, kitchen, study, cellar/stairs.
- Movement, mouse/touch look, sprint/stamina, collisions, flashlight, pickups, inventory, notes, breaker puzzle, cellar door, iron key, win/death states.
- Handgun viewmodel, shooting, ammo/reload, enemy model/AI/pathfinding, enemy attack, stun/death.
- Procedural audio, lightning, dust, flickering lights, title camera.
- Debug API `window.__BLACKWATER__`.
- Fixed win-screen bug where a permanent cream `.white-fade` overlay hid the win screen; replaced with `@keyframes whiteout`.
- Redesigned mask and portrait textures.
- Reworked gun viewmodel materials/geometry/position for desktop and mobile readability.
- Added README game description, objective, run instructions, and controls table.
- Verified full loop end-to-end: kitchen fuse → study fuse → breaker/power → cellar door → key → front door → win.
- Verified pause/resume, notes, win overlay, death overlay, enemy chase/attack, gun kill, mobile joystick/look, mobile fire button, landscape layout, and no console/network errors.
- Verified A* paths to all new patrol points.
- Verified win overlay is dark and visible after the whiteout animation.

### Active
- Final visual-review pass after the latest ammo-box and lighting changes.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Inspect latest `screenshots/view-kitchen.png` (and other room shots) to confirm the new dark-green ammo box and increased lighting still look correct.
2. Re-run `node --check src/*.js` after all edits.
3. Re-run a final desktop/mobile gameplay screenshot check.
4. Consider whether further viewmodel/lighting polish is necessary; otherwise finish.
5. Leave changes uncommitted unless the user requests a commit.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: markup for title, HUD, overlays, touch controls.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: full UI styling, responsive/mobile rules, whiteout animation.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: game loop, input, interactions, enemy AI, gunplay, viewmodel, win/death, debug API.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: world geometry, props, lights, enemy mesh, static merge, patrol-relevant colliders.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/textures.js`: procedural textures, including redesigned mask and portrait.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: procedural Web Audio soundscape.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three.module.js`: Three.js r160 runtime.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/BufferGeometryUtils.js`: geometry merging.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/fonts/`: vendored Bodoni Moda and Barlow Condensed fonts.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: game description, run instructions, controls.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: generated validation screenshots (gitignored).

## Important Context
- Local server runs as `python3 -m http.server 3002` in tmux session `game`; URL `http://localhost:3002`.
- Browser testing uses Node Playwright with `executablePath: '/usr/bin/chromium'` and args `['--use-angle=swiftshader','--no-sandbox']`.
- Headless software rendering runs slowly and clamps `dt`; tests need long waits (e.g., ~9s for a 1.55s reload), and screenshots can take several seconds.
- Debug API exposes `teleport(x,z,yaw)`, `powerOn()`, `spawnEnemy()`, `giveAll()`, `interact()`, `fire()`, plus `game/player/world/enemy/camera/renderer/nav/findPath`.
- World coords: house x∈[-9,9], z∈[-6,9]; cellar z∈[-11,-6], floor y=-1.8; hall x∈[-2,2]; breaker `(1.89,1.5,-1.2)`; kitchen fuse `(8.02,0.94,-3.35)`; study fuse `(-6.55,0.86,-4.02)`; key `(0,-0.77,-9.82)`; gun `(5.25,0.91,5.03)`; ammo `(8.02,0.985,-1.18)`.
